asset_ownership_interpretation: The Nuri Bitcoin Interest Account was separately contracted with Celsius. The Celsius Earn Decision concluded that assets deposited in Earn accounts became Celsius property and estate assets, subject to reserved creditor defenses.
notes: This classification applies only to the Celsius-linked interest account and not to ordinary Nuri bank balances, custody wallets or self-custodial vaults.
